user.title: Connect a local Bestway spa
user.description: Enter the spa’s home-network IPv4 address or hostname. The spa must already be on Wi-Fi; no Bestway account is needed. Only confirmed AirJet V01 profiles are enabled.

reconfigure.title: Update the spa address
reconfigure.description: The new address must identify the same physical spa. Wi-Fi recovery requires joining its hotspot using the recovery helper.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach or read the spa. Check that it is on the same reachable network, then try again. If it is in AP mode, use the Wi-Fi recovery guide.
error.authentication_failed: Local login is unavailable. A physical binding window or the previously saved local passcode may be required. Do not reset Wi-Fi just to retry login.
error.unsupported_device: This device’s product key is not supported. See the compatibility and extension guide.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address or hostname, without a URL, spaces or port.

abort.already_configured: This spa is already configured. Use Reconfigure to change its address.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different spa.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Read state every 15 seconds by default. Failed reads back off up to five minutes. Heartbeats maintain the connection separately.

spa_unreachable.title: Bestway spa is unavailable
spa_unreachable.description: {name} has stopped responding on its home network. Check power, Wi-Fi signal and its DHCP address. If the pump exposes its setup hotspot, follow the standalone Wi-Fi recovery guide from a phone joined to that hotspot. Home Assistant cannot send provisioning packets to an AP it cannot reach.
